mechanism_claims.claim_text: Peptides were directly assayed for LPS/endotoxin binding and serum endotoxin activity reduction; effectiveness depends on peptide family, acylation, and serum context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level exact bar values are not reconstructed beyond source text/caption statements; no supplementary numeric table is present locally.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: N-acylated LF11 peptides were directly tested for E. coli outer-membrane permeabilization by NPN uptake, with C12 acylation reported as strongest in that assay context.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Qualitative/relative interpretation retained; exact figure trace values were not locally tabulated.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM provided direct morphology evidence of bacterial cell damage after AMP exposure, supporting nonselective bacterial membrane damage rather than a target-specific intracellular mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LF11-322-C8 and PMB comparator in E. coli/S. aureus cultures
mechanism_claims.limitations: SEM supports membrane/cell-envelope damage phenotype; it does not define a molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Blood-compatibility effects including hemolysis, coagulation, platelet activation, leukocyte viability, and complement activation are toxicity/compatibility findings, not antimicrobial mechanism closure.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Compatibility endpoints are recorded as safety phenotypes; they are not promoted to antimicrobial mechanism claims.
